question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Commute
solution:
The correct answer is **"Convert"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's see the meanings of the given words-
 
 
• **Commute-** to reduce (a judicial sentence, especially a sentence of death) to another less severe one or to travel some distance between one's home and place of work on a regular basis
 
• **Synonyms of commute are:** trade, swap, exchange, change, substitute, shift, switch, interchange, replace, etc.
 
• **Condense- **make (something) denser or more concentrated.
 
• **Convert- **change the form, character, or function of something.
 
• **Conserve- **protect (something, especially something of environmental or cultural importance) from harm or destruction.
 
• **Consume- **eat, drink, or ingest (food or drink).
 
 
 
• Hence, according to the meanings of the given words, the correct answer is **"Convert" i.e. Option 2.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] Hinglish__**

 
• आइए देखें दिए गए शब्दों के अर्थ-
 
 
• **Commute- **एक न्यायिक सजा को कम करना, विशेष रूप से मौत की सजा को कम गंभीर सजा देना; अपने घर और कार्यस्थल के बीच नियमित रूप से कुछ दूरी तय करना

 
 
• Synonyms: trade, swap, exchange, change, substitute, shift, switch, interchange, replace, etc.
 
 
 
• **Condense- ** (कुछ) सघन या अधिक केंद्रित करना।
 
• **Convert- **किसी चीज़ के रूप, चरित्र या कार्य को बदलना।
 
• **Conserve- **रक्षा करना, सुरक्षित रखना
 
• **Consume- **खाना, काम में लाना
